label: First row per group
example: ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY id ORDER BY d)

uses.title: 1174 · Immediate first deliveries
uses.snippet:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date) AS rn
    FROM Delivery
)

uses.title: 1164 · Product price at a given date
uses.snippet:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT product_id, new_price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY change_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Products WHERE change_date <= '2019-08-16'
), ids AS (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM Products)
